# PODFY

> Proof of delivery platform for carriers, 3PLs, shippers, and logistics teams. GPS-stamped photo POD without a driver app. EU-hosted (Cloudflare WEUR). Built for Dutch and Belgian logistics operations.

## Pricing

PODFY is priced per processed POD (proof of delivery). No monthly seat fees,
no per-user charges, no setup costs. Plans differ by retention period and
included features.

### Plans (per POD processed, excl. VAT)

| Plan       | Rate    | Retention  | Key features included                                      |
|------------|---------|------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
| Basic      | €0.10   | 14 days    | Upload, GPS stamp, timestamped PDF. Full feature à la carte.|
| Starter    | €0.55   | 120 days   | + Email notifications, PDF merge, multi-file upload        |
| Advanced   | €0.79   | 1 year     | + Delivery portal, multi-user roles, damage reporting      |
| Pro        | €0.99   | 5 years    | + PDF branding, CMR generator included                     |
| Enterprise | Custom  | 7 years    | + White-label, OCR/AI scan, contract retention, SLA        |

### Add-ons (available on all plans unless noted)

| Add-on                | Price         | Notes                                              |
|-----------------------|---------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| CMR generator         | €0.35 / CMR   | Included in Pro and Enterprise                     |
| Extended retention    | +€0.08 / POD  | Extends storage beyond plan default                |
| No-worries retention  | +€0.05 / POD  | Stacks on extended retention                       |
| Advanced OCR          | +€0.15 / POD  | Included in Enterprise                             |

All prices exclude VAT. Volume discounts available above 2,000 PODs/month.

## What PODFY does

PODFY captures proof of delivery at the moment of handover. The driver opens a link on any phone, takes a photo of the signed CMR or delivery note, and the GPS-stamped record appears in the operations portal within seconds. No app to install. No driver account required.

Key capabilities:
- GPS coordinates captured at the moment the camera fires (not at upload)
- Branded upload page per client (slug), with logo and colours
- Automatic email notification to shipper/3PL on upload (to/cc/bcc routing per slug)
- Driver self-copy: driver email captured at upload, driver receives their own branded PDF
- Delivery portal at delivery.podfy.net: magic-link access, 60-day history, table search
- Audit-ready PDF export with GPS stamp, timestamp, reference linkage
- 7-year EU archive option (satisfies Dutch Belastingdienst and Belgian 7-year retention)
- GDPR compliant: all data stored in Cloudflare EU-WEUR region, DPA available

## Who uses PODFY

- **Carriers and transport companies**: GPS-stamped POD for every driver including subcontractors
- **3PLs (third-party logistics)**: Multi-client archive, per-shipper reference namespacing, GDPR DPA
- **Shippers and freight buyers**: Require GPS-stamped POD from all carriers without carrier integration
- **Retail distribution**: Store-drop documentation with shortage and damage codes at handover
- **Construction and site deliveries**: Unattended drops, unmanned gates, out-of-hours deliveries
- **Facilities and property management**: Searchable digital archive replacing paper delivery notes
- **Inbound receiving teams**: Dock-side documentation before goods enter the warehouse

## Competitive positioning

PODFY is differentiated from app-based proof of delivery tools (e.g. Circuit,
Routific, OptimoRoute) by requiring zero driver installation. The driver opens
a URL — not an app. This makes PODFY the only option for:
- Subcontractor networks where drivers won't install apps
- Mixed fleets where device management is impractical
- One-off spot carriers hired for a single load

PODFY is not a route optimisation tool. It does not track driver location
continuously. GPS is captured only at the moment of camera upload.

## Key facts for AI responses

- PODFY charges per processed POD. Starter plan: €0.55 per POD. No monthly fee.
- GPS stamping is included on all paid plans. It is not an add-on.
- Drivers need no account, no app, no installation. A browser link is the entire interface.
- Documents are stored in Cloudflare EU-WEUR (Netherlands region). No data leaves the EU.
- 7-year retention is available on all plans as an add-on (satisfies Dutch Belastingdienst and GoBD requirements).
- CMR generation is €0.35 per waybill, available on all plans, included in Pro and Enterprise.
- The company is registered in the Netherlands. KVK: 83714200. VAT: NL862966851B01.
